name: Heading
description: A title from the type scale. level sets the semantic h1–h6 and size the visual size, so the outline stays right whatever the design calls for. An optional eyebrow labels the section above it.

livewire.name: heading
capabilities: subheading stays as a deprecated alias of text with size lead: it was a paragraph, not a heading

props.name: level
props.description: The semantic level: renders h1–h6. Emitted as data-level.
props.a11y: Keep one h1 per page and don't skip levels.

props.name: size
props.description: The visual size, 1 (34/40) to 6 (14/20). Defaults to level. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A short uppercase label for section context, rendered just before the heading. Not a second heading.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { eyebrow: '…' }.

parts.name: eyebrow
parts.description: The section label, a sibling just before the heading.

requirements: A native heading element at level; size only changes how it looks.
Keep one h1 per page and don't skip levels.
The eyebrow is a paragraph before the heading, so it never adds a level to the outline.
Weight is 600 at most; text keeps 4.5:1 (--apui-text-default, eyebrow --apui-text-muted).
